title: Informational MINOR findings must not count as unsuccessful rounds against the review escalation limit
definitionOfDone: A round whose only own findings are non-blocking (MINOR, failing no criterion/required check) is treated as clean for the escalation decision: past the limit WITH an operator continuation it routes ACCEPT; the findings are still recorded in the lineage. Kernel test asserts the exact route and reason codes for: clean, MINOR-only, MAJOR, and MINOR-only WITHOUT continuation (still ESCALATE past the limit).
A round carrying a MAJOR / criterion-failing finding still routes REJECT_*/ESCALATE exactly as today; a mutation drill deleting the severity distinction reds.
unsuccessfulRounds remains part of the lineage digest; a hand-reset counter is still refused (existing anti-tamper arm stays green).

Reproduced against the UnAI shape: a submission with one informational MINOR after 3 unsuccessful rounds + a continuation reaches ACCEPT and the verifier runs (record the command and result in planningNotes).
Escalation card copy (control room) states the rule: what a continuation rescues, and that informational findings no longer block it.
reopenReason: DELIVERED ELSEWHERE — archived on the owner's instruction after governor verification 2026-09-18. Measured at origin/main (packages/review/src/review-findings.ts): `const blocking = own.filter((record) => record.finding.severity !== "MINOR")` at :216 and `const clean = blocking.length === 0` at :221, with the rule stated at :209-212 — only a CRITICAL or MAJOR own finding blocks a round; a MINOR one is recorded and informational. That is exactly this row's subject. It landed as cb503a58 and reached main in landing 8a14f3b1. Nothing left to implement.

comments.author: owner-session
comments.content: Delivered on main 16c70ec8 (fix10 batch, main 31b8191b, 2026-09-18). Control room: the "Review exhausted" card now says what "Allow one more attempt" funds (one more round, accepted unless a CRITICAL or MAJOR finding appears), what Replan does, that guidance is optional and reaches the seat verbatim; findings render with severity and an all-MINOR list reads as non-blocking (capped lists say "All 8 listed findings…"); the guidance sentence renders only with its textbox. Kernel: packages/review/src/review-continuation.ts reviewContinuationAccepts now disqualifies only an unattributed CRITICAL/MAJOR record past sourceRound (DoD item 4 was NOT met at 8a14f3b1: the continuation could never rescue an all-MINOR round, so the operator's "Allow one more attempt" looped on UnAI). packages/review/CLAUDE.md updated. needs-you-escalation.test.tsx 31/31, approvals folder 259/259, packages/review 163/163; drills red exactly their arms.
